summary: Memory prefetch and conflict-checked phase-locks are preconditions for governed writes on the Claude Code surface. Enforced at the PreToolUse boundary by a fail-closed gate, not by model discretion. Validated in CI against the registered hook wiring.

prefetch.note: SessionStart never blocks a session. On success it writes a session receipt; ABSENCE of a fresh receipt is what causes the PreToolUse gate to deny governed writes. Fail-open here plus fail-closed at the write boundary yields net fail-closed for governed mutations without ever bricking session startup.

gate.note: Emits a PreToolUse permissionDecision. Denies a matched governed write when its required preconditions are unmet.

writeback.note: Best-effort deterministic episode ingest at session end.

session_prefetch.satisfied_by: a session receipt under state.session_receipt_glob whose session_id matches the current session and whose age is < state.session_ttl_seconds

phase_lock.satisfied_by: a lock artifact under state.lock_glob for at least one required namespace, conflict-checked, unexpired (< state.lock_ttl_seconds), and bound to the current session

governed_writes.description: Edits to governance-authority paths require prefetch and a conflict-checked phase-lock.
Any other edit still requires that memory was prefetched this session.
Local history mutation and publication require prefetch and a phase-lock.
External GitHub writes (PR create/update, merge, direct file push) require prefetch and a phase-lock.

operator_override.note: Operator-only break-glass. When this environment variable holds a non-empty reason string, the gate allows the call and records an override event to the writeback log. It is supplied by the account environment; the agent cannot set it for its own hook subprocesses. The agent never has the choice; the human operator retains override.

disable_env.note: Operator-only. Set to 'off' to disable enforcement (e.g. surfaces with no memory endpoint). Default is 'on'. Absent or any value other than 'off' means enforced.
